sentences.en: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.
sentences.zh: 说话时必须要有礼貌，不要说出下流的话。

sentences.en: His obscene remarks will be expunged from the record.
sentences.zh: 他那些下流的言论将从记录中删除。

sentences.en: Or are there photographs so obscene that you can't publish them?
sentences.zh: 或者有如此下流的照片你无法刊登吗？

senses.zh: 淫秽的，暴力的；道德败坏的，令人厌恶的；（数量等）大得惊人的，骇人听闻的
